name: smwgraphics-social-media-icons
title: Social Media Icons
description:
This is a pack with 14 popular social media icons. Useful if you want to show your profile on a social media in your hack, cutscenes etc. Uses blank halves on rows 5 and 6, also SMW last yellow palletes of row 6.

Social media that the pack contains:

-Facebook
-YouTube
-Twitter (R.I.P.)
-X (New Twitter)
-WhatsApp
-TikTok or Douyin
-Instagram
-Kwai
-Pinterest
-Messenger
-LinkedIn
-Snapchat
-VK (VKontakte)
-Reddit
